messages:
taylor.smith: Heads up — BrightPath Health POC signed. Need a dedicated GPU pool for a 2-week POC. Who can own provisioning?
priya.kapoor: Congrats! Can you paste expected qps, model details, and preferred region/SKU?
taylor.smith: Model mix: 7B chat + 13B instruct. Peak concurrent requests ~50, avg seq len 512, target p95 latency <300ms. Region preference: us-west2 (primary) with us-central as fallback. Prefer H100 but A100-80GB acceptable. Need isolated pool + private networking. POC duration 14 days, start target Mon 2026-03-30. Need cost estimate.
devin.lee: We can provision A100-80GB in us-west2. H100 capacity is tight in us-west2 right now — I'll check inventory. For 50 concurrent @512 tokens, rough estimate is 3x A100-80GB to cover burst + KV cache headroom if models are quantized. What precision will they run (FP16 / int8)?
taylor.smith: They want int8 quantized variants to save cost. Also need an API key fallback to hosted, plus IP allowlist and AAD SSO for their engineers.
priya.kapoor: For Dedicated POC I'd recommend starting with 3x A100-80GB in us-west2. Autoscale can be disabled for the short POC and we keep a small buffer. We'll arrange VPC peering + VPN for private networking. I'll send the security questionnaire and onboarding form — KMS ARN and IP ranges needed.
jordan.ci: Quick pricing note: short-term dedicated pro-rate is applied. Placeholder estimate: ~ $2,400/day for 3x A100-80GB (final quote pending inventory and term). Will prepare formal quote + approval flow. Any regulatory needs (HIPAA, SOC2)?
taylor.smith: They require HIPAA (BA to be signed) and audit logs. Also want customer-managed keys if possible.
devin.lee: Good news: Dedicated supports CMEK integration in our cloud for supported regions — we can accept a customer KMS ARN. For audit logs we can stream to their cloud bucket (S3/GCS) with 90-day retention. We'll need the KMS ARN, IAM principal, and IP ranges before provisioning.
deploy-bot: ticket created: DED-7892 — Dedicated pool provision request (us-west2, 3x A100-80GB). Assigned to @devin.lee. ETA estimate: 4 business days once questionnaire + KMS + IP allowlist are provided.
priya.kapoor: :thumbsup: I'll DM BrightPath the security form and request the KMS ARN + IP ranges. I'll also add a canary model/profile to the pool to reduce cold starts for chat.
taylor.smith: Also need a scoped hosted API key as a fallback route if the dedicated pool is overloaded. Can the key be rate-limited and org-scoped?
devin.lee: Yes — we can generate a scoped API key for their org and attach a fallback routing policy. We'll set failover after 3 consecutive 502s and enforce a soft rate limit to avoid cost surprise.
taylor.smith: Great. Please keep me posted. I told BrightPath we need provisioning complete by 2026-03-28 for smoke tests ahead of the 3/30 start.
priya.kapoor: Noted. I'll update DED-7892 with checklist: security form received, KMS ARN, IP allowlist, signed BA, quote approval, and smoke test signoff. Ping me if customer gets stuck filling the form.
taylor.smith: :rocket: thanks team.
